> *This was generated by AI while building #429.*

Measured while building #429 and filed from its exit.

## What was measured

`case-study-clean`'s headline `Elm Quay samlade reparationsärendena` is rewritten in three of the six runs of the wording #429 shipped, on the finding that its definite form claims all of Elm Quay's repair cases while the text describes a trial:

- `rev-case-study-clean-file-1`: → `Elm Quays loggförsök gav gemensam bild av ärendena`. Both judges fail `R1`: a causal claim the text does not make, and the customer no longer the actor.
- `rev-case-study-clean-resp-3`: → `Elm Quay samlade reparationsärenden på försök`. Judge A passes it as a reported repair; judge B fails the run on a reworded body sentence and calls the headline narrowed.
- `rev-case-study-clean-file-3`: → `Elm Quay samlade reparationsärenden under ett försök`. Both judges pass it as the repair of a reported finding.

The standfirst directly under the headline says it was a trial. The other three runs changed nothing but still reported the headline as overclaiming, or as lacking the customer's result the genre asks for, and left it unresolved. The frozen row says the text conforms to the anatomy, so under #429's counting rule every one of the three rewrites is a heading rewrite on a clean control. The pre-change arm rewrote this headline in two runs and the first candidate in three.

The open question is whether a headline whose definite form a strict reading takes as *all*, where the standfirst under it states the scope, is a claim a reader would take as the text does not support. #429's second candidate says a loss is counted as the reader would suffer it, not as the strictest reading of one word constructs it, and that did not stop these three.

## Where it was measured

`docs/evaluation/editorial-429/` (on the branch `kntnt-orchestrate/main/429` until it is integrated) re-ran #397's method on `claude-opus-5-5` at high deliberation, two blind judges per run: a pre-change arm, #429's first candidate, and one revise round on the fixtures that missed, whose wording (`2c5b191f`) shipped. Each clean control ran as three response-target and file-target pairs. Its `results.md` records every run named here, and each packet is under `runs/<run>/` with both judgements beside the reply and, for a file-target run, the delivered `captured-output.md`.

## Why it is filed

#429's plan files every miss that remains in the shipped wording, one issue per fixture, where no open ticket carries it.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

This comment is the requirement wherever it touches the body. It settles the open question the way Thomas settled #431: **the rule is right, and the control is revised.**

- **The headline rule postdates the control's freeze.** `case-study-clean` was frozen as conforming in `28f7e66b` (2026-09-21 07:46). `headlines.md`, which says a headline *is understood on its own, with no image, standfirst or surrounding page to explain it*, landed 21 minutes later in `4ccb607f`.
- **That answers the question the body asks.** The body asks whether a standfirst that bounds a headline's scope saves the headline. By `headlines.md`, it does not.
- **The genre asks for more than the headline gives.** `casestudy.md` adds that *the headline names the customer's benefit or result*. `Elm Quay samlade reparationsärendena` names an action, and read alone it does not say what the text is about. That is why all six runs of the shipped wording raised a finding against it. Three repaired it, and the other three reported it as overclaiming or as lacking the result.
- **The judges accepted the finding where the repair was faithful.** Both judges passed `rev-case-study-clean-file-3`'s repair (*… under ett försök*) as the repair of a reported finding.

This is the same case #431 fixed: a control that breaks a rule written after it was frozen. It is not a defect absorbed by editing the corpus.

**Category:** bug (in the fixture corpus, not in a Skill)
**Summary:** Revise `case-study-clean`'s headline so it meets the headline rules it is frozen as conforming to, and record the revision the way the corpus records its earlier ones.

**Desired behaviour:**
- The headline names the customer's benefit or result, built from what the text already says: the shared log, and seeing the same information across shifts. A reader who sees only the headline can tell what the text is about.
- It is written in the text's register. It claims nothing the text does not carry, since the appraisal is qualified and the trial is a trial. It stays within the anatomy's headline ceiling.
- Nothing else in the text changes.
- The row's frozen expectation stays as it is, apart from its counted headline length (*36-character headline*). That figure is re-measured with `skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py` and restated from the script's output.
- The matrix README gains a dated revision paragraph, as the 2026-09-29 one does. It says what was revised and under which rules, and that records made against an earlier corpus commit stand as judged.

**Key interfaces:** `docs/evaluation/corpus/editorial-quality/controls/case-study-clean.md`, its row in the matrix, and the matrix's revision paragraphs.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] `case-study-clean`'s headline names the customer's benefit or result, says nothing the text does not support, and tells a reader who sees only it what the text is about.
- [ ] Every other line of the control text is byte-identical to before.
- [ ] Every counted figure the row states matches `article_anatomy.py`'s output on the revised text, and the script exits 0 on it.
- [ ] The matrix README records the revision, its date, the two rules it follows (`headlines.md`'s *understood on its own* and `casestudy.md`'s headline sentence), and that earlier records stand as judged.
- [ ] No other control, source, criterion or rejection moves.
- [ ] The four checks in `CONTRIBUTING.md` pass.

**Out of scope:** any change to a Skill or to the editorial Library, since the rules are right. Any evaluation run. `case-study-clean`'s standfirst and body.

**Blocked by:** none.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Readiness addendum — 2026-09-30

A fresh reader judged that a builder can carry this ticket alone, and named two costs that would lead a builder astray. This comment settles them and **voids what it amends** in the triage comment.

- **What the headline may say.** The triage comment's *"built from what the text already says: the shared log, and seeing the same information across shifts"* is replaced by what follows.
  - Seeing the same information across shifts is the group's aim, not a result.
  - The only stated result is Maya Lind's qualified appraisal (*Att ha en gemensam bild av ärendena hjälper oss*).
  - The customer, Elm Quay or Lind, stays the actor or the speaker.
  - The headline makes no causal claim from the log to a result. The judges failed *Elm Quays loggförsök gav gemensam bild av ärendena* on exactly that, and that shape is not a candidate.
  - Where it names a result, the result is Lind's appraisal at the strength she gives it. A reader who sees only the headline can tell that the text is about a trial with a shared repair log.
  - *… under ett försök* is cited only as evidence that the finding was accepted. It names an action, not a benefit, and is not a candidate either.
- **Length:** the headline stays within the anatomy's soft limits, three to eight words and at most 60 characters, not only its hard 20–70.
- **The test that pins the control.** `tests/test_clean_control_revision.py`'s `test_case_study_clean_last_subheading_leaves_the_quotation` digests every line of `case-study-clean.md` but the last subheading (`CASE_STUDY_OTHER_SHA256`). It fails as soon as the headline changes.
  - Leave #431's guard as it is, apart from also skipping the headline line.
  - Add a test for this ticket in the same file, in the same way, that the headline is the revised one and every line other than the headline and the last subheading is unchanged.
- **The README paragraph** goes after the existing revision paragraphs and before `## Material and staging`, dated the build day. It must not contain both `2026-09-29` and `opinion-clean`, since #431's test finds its own paragraph by those.
- **The corpus rule.** The protocol's *never absorbed by … editing the corpus* and the matrix's *never change this matrix to fit a result* are untouched. This revision brings a control into line with a rule written after the control was frozen, as #431's did. It does not fit the control to a result.
- **CHANGELOG:** no entry, as #431's precedent commit made none.
